title: Closed Range and Essential Norms of Composition Operators on Weighted Dirichlet Spaces
summary: We study closed range and essential norms of bounded composition operators $C_\varphi$ on weighted Dirichlet spaces $\mathcal{D}_α$. For $-1 -1$, we establish two-sided essential norm estimates in terms of local averages of the generalized Nevanlinna counting function and an exact formula using boundary tail integrals. If the normalized counting density has vanishing oscillation at the boundary, we obtain exact formulas in terms of its boundary limsup, Berezin transform, and local averages.
